note: Natal charts, Vimshottari dashas and transits-to-natal for the subjects whose birth date is genuinely sourced. No ascendant and no houses: the first-trade time is unpublished, so they would be invented. discipline: This is what the tradition SAYS about these charts. It is not a forecast and not advice. The transit-only claims the desk could test showed no edge on PSX (see astro_backtest.json); the natal methods here are not yet tested, and are labelled untested rather than sold as insight.
